bossinfo.title: THE LANTERN WARDEN
bossinfo.sub: He feeds the dark one star at a time
bossinfo.victory: The lantern breaks. One star goes free.

bossinfo.title: THE PALE CHOIR
bossinfo.sub: They sing the stars to sleep
bossinfo.victory: The lullaby ends. Under the ice, the stars wake up.

bossinfo.title: THE HOLLOWMOTH
bossinfo.sub: It ate the moon. It ate Nana. It is still hungry.
bossinfo.victory: The Hollowmoth is gone. The stars are free.
